The system that allowed dangerous research to go unchecked, let government scientists take Big Pharma money in secret, and shielded vaccine makers from accountability is still in place. I've introduced three bills to change that because the American people deserve to know a pandemic can never happen again.

Proud to earn an A rating from @sbaprolife. Their mission is simple: elect leaders and pass laws that save innocent lives. That is exactly the kind of fight I show up for every day in the Senate. I’m grateful to stand alongside them.

I cast my vote in Kentucky. Grateful for the freedom to participate in self-government and thankful for everyone working the polls today. If you haven’t voted yet, make a plan and get out there and vote early or on Election Day, this Tuesday, May 19.

When the establishment spends $2.5 million to take out one congressman, you know he's doing something right. Stand with @MassieforKY and join the Massie Money Bomb.


Thomas Massie for Congress (@MassieforKY)

Just in the week leading up to the election, AIPAC has purchased over $1.5 million of anti-Massie advertising and Miriam Adelson’s superPAC has purchased $1 million of anti-Massie advertising.

Can you keep my pro-Massie ads on TV by donating to massiemoneybomb.com ?

I've spent years demanding answers about COVID's origins. I've been called a conspiracy theorist for it. On Wednesday, a decorated CIA officer testified under oath that the lab leak conclusion was real and that it was deliberately suppressed. The truth is finally coming out.


The Washington Times (@WashTimes)

CIA scientists repeatedly concluded that COVID-19 most likely leaked from a Chinese lab -- and were pushed to revise those findings until the conclusion disappeared, a whistleblower told

A CIA whistleblower testified under oath that Biden's intel community buried the lab leak conclusion. Not once, but multiple times between 2021 and 2023. That’s the very definition of a cover-up.

foxnews.com/politics/top-4-e…

Yesterday's hearing made one thing clear: Washington knew more about COVID origins than they ever admitted.

I've been demanding answers for years. The cover-up is unraveling. Fauci and his cronies have nowhere left to hide.

foxnews.com/video/6395433392…

ICYMI: Fauci went to the CIA and overruled their own scientists. He commissioned papers in secret, then cited them as independent evidence. The people determining the origin were the same ones who funded the research.

The cover-up is unraveling. More is coming. 

@WillCainShow

Video
The American people funded this research. They were lied to about it. They deserve full transparency and real accountability. I will not stop until they get it. The fight for truth goes on.

Six years later, millions of people are dead. Trillions of dollars were spent. Our civil liberties were shredded by mandates and lockdowns. And the man at the center of it all has never faced a single consequence. That ends now.

Now about that pardon. Biden's autopen pardon of Fauci may not be valid. If Biden did not personally sign it, it is legally suspect. The only way to test it is for the DOJ to charge someone covered by one of these pardons. I have a suggestion for the test case: Dr. Anthony Fauci.

USAID funneled $54 million to EcoHealth Alliance to collect bat coronaviruses and transport them to Wuhan for gain-of-function research. I demanded answers from the Biden administration. I was stonewalled. USAID kept sending money for years after the connection was exposed.

I've subpoenaed 14 federal agencies for records on COVID origins and risky research. I've referred Fauci for criminal prosecution multiple times for allegedly lying to Congress. I've uncovered evidence that he deleted official records. The stonewalling has been relentless.

Federal records were deleted. Investigations were obstructed. Emails show a deliberate campaign to silence scientists who questioned the narrative. This is not incompetence. This is a cover-up. And it cost lives.
